simple.meaning: קִדְמָה (qidmâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “the forward part (or relatively) East (often adverbially, on the east or in front).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: קִדְמָה (H6926) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 2:14, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Samuel, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קִדְמָה (H6926) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in קִדְמָה (H6926) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: קִדְמָה (qidmâh) / H6926 is traced through Genesis 2:14, Genesis 4:16, 1 Samuel 13:5, Ezekiel 39:11 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

timeline.evidenceText: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.
Cain left Yahweh’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the seashore in multitude. They came up and encamped in Michmash, eastward of Beth Aven.

“ ‘ “It will happen in that day, that I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the valley of those who pass through on the east of the sea; and it will stop those who pass through. They will bury Gog and all his multitude there; and they will call it ‘The valley of Hamon Gog’.

definitions.short: the forward part (or relatively) East (often adverbially, on the east or in front)
definitions.full: H6926. qidmah [ קִדְמָה ] noun feminine front, East ; — only construct קִדְמַת as preposition: 1 in front of, over against (compare Nö ZMG xxxiii (1879), 532 ), Gen 2:14 (i.e. from standpoint of writer; really, on geographic grounds, = west of; yet see Di ed. 6 ), 4:16 (both J), 2 on the east of , Ezek 39:11 ; 1Sam 13:5 may be either.
